name: Jupiter Infomedia Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2005, Jupiter Infomedia Ltd
is in the business of Web Based Solutions 
and Investment Services.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
JIL a web-info media company that owns and manages online portals related to Business, Encyclopedia, Yellow pages and SME news Portal.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.73% over past five years.
Working capital days have increased from 205 days to 369 days
